name: Saral Bijli Bill Scheme
benefit: - **Free Electricity Connection:** Eligible registered labourers and construction workers receive free domestic electricity connections without any connection charge. - **Fixed Monthly Electricity Bill:** The beneficiary is required to pay only ₹200 per month for electricity consumption.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a registered labourer under the Mukhyamantri Mazdoor Kalyan (Sambal) Yojana–2018. - The applicant should be a registered construction worker. - The applicant should have a domestic electricity connection or intend to obtain one under this scheme.
